errors.what: Coupler end and rocker end do not coincide at joint B: the rocker tip is visibly detached from the coupler tip (about 20 px, i.e. about 20 mm at the 1 px/mm scale). At t=0 the coupler end sits at about (136,71) mm, which is the correct B for the specified lengths, but the rocker is drawn at the wrong angle (about 77 deg instead of about 62 deg), so the loop does not close. The rocker angle or phase is wrong.
